title: EStopSafeStateAndTractionIsolationSchemaV2
description: Rigorous physical signal transition sequence, probe definitions, and state separation for vehicle emergency stop, separating motor line current cutoff from DC bus isolation and mechanical brake engagement.

t0_estop_command.definition: The exact physical instant when the normally-closed (NC) dual-channel E-Stop push-button or wireless safety relay contacts break.
t0_estop_command.probe_point: Wireless Safety Receiver Channel 1/2 NC contact terminals (24VDC -> 0VDC edge).

t1_safety_output.definition: Safety relay internal logic de-energization time.
t1_safety_output.probe_point: Safety controller OSSD or relay output terminals.

t2_contactor_diagnostic_transition.definition: Mechanical separation of the main traction contactor armature and opening of its auxiliary feedback microswitch.
t2_contactor_diagnostic_transition.probe_point: Main contactor auxiliary normally-open (NO) status microswitch (24VDC -> 0VDC).
t2_contactor_diagnostic_transition.semantic_role: DIAGNOSTIC_PRECURSOR (Verifies contactor movement; does not prove electrical isolation).

t3_traction_safe_state.definition: The authoritative kinetic safety endpoint where high-voltage traction motor line current drops below safe threshold (I_motor < 0.5 A RMS), verifying immediate torque cessation.
t3_traction_safe_state.probe_point: Calibrated Hall-effect current clamp (e.g. Tektronix TCP303 / A622) on motor Phase U conductor.

traction_current_safe.definition: Motor phase line current I_motor < 0.5 A RMS.
traction_current_safe.measurement_method: Hall-effect current probe on motor stator phase lead.
traction_current_safe.role: Direct proof of electric motor torque elimination.

brake_applied.definition: Physical mechanical engagement of friction brake pads against the wheel/disc assembly.
brake_applied.control_signal_separation: BRAKE_COIL_DEENERGIZED (solenoid voltage drops to 0V) is an electrical actuation signal, NOT mechanical engagement. Mechanical pad displacement requires spring travel time (typically 15-35 ms after coil drop). True BRAKE_APPLIED is measured via vehicle deceleration profile (accelerometer >= 1.5 m/s^2) or caliper mechanical proximity sensor.
brake_applied.measurement_method: IMU longitudinal deceleration trace AND brake coil voltage monitor.

contactor_open.definition: Physical separation of the main contactor contacts.
contactor_open.qualification: Microswitch status indicates armature travel but cannot detect contact contact welding or plasma arcing.

dc_bus_isolated.definition: Galvanic disconnection of the battery pack and complete discharge of inverter DC link capacitance (V_bus < 50.0 VDC).
dc_bus_isolated.separation_from_motor_current: I_motor < 0.5 A DOES NOT EQUAL DC_BUS_ISOLATED. Inverter IGBTs gate off in < 1 ms (cutting motor current to zero), but inverter DC link bulk capacitors can store hazardous voltage (> 50 V) for seconds or minutes. DC-bus isolation requires an independent differential high-voltage probe measurement (V_bus < 50V).
dc_bus_isolated.measurement_method: High-voltage differential oscilloscope probe across inverter DC+ and DC- bus terminals.

component_certification.definition: Vendor certificate issued by an accredited Notified Body (e.g. TÜV Rheinland) certifying that an individual component (e.g. Pilz safety relay, Sick scanner) satisfies IEC 61508 SIL-3 or ISO 13849-1 Cat 4 / PLe in isolation.

system_architecture.definition: Circuit topology and wiring implementation (dual-channel cross-monitored loop, pulsed diagnostic outputs) designed to achieve Category 4 architecture.

integrated_safety_function.definition: The complete, end-to-end safety loop combining sensor inputs, safety relay logic, contactors, inverter disable circuits, and mechanical brakes on this specific physical research vehicle.
integrated_safety_function.limitation: A vendor component certificate DOES NOT certify the integrated safety function of the vehicle.

field_validation.definition: Comprehensive on-site empirical testing proving that the integrated safety function executes safely under all operational load and speed conditions.
field_validation.classification: SYSTEM_SAFETY_VALIDATION (To be performed only after physical commissioning)

gate_c8_acceptance_rule.authoritative_rule: delta_t_traction <= 50.0 ms (I_motor < 0.5 A) AND t_contactor_change <= 35.0 ms AND VENDOR_CERTIFICATION_REQUIREMENT satisfied for safety relay and E-Stop switch.
